lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap through the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API. The dataset includes structural information (building type, levels, materials) and address attributes derived from crowdsourced mapping contributions, with coverage validation against AI-based building detection estimates.
